facts.title: Mega Crunchy Romaine Salad with Quinoa
ingredients: 1 small head of romaine (about 11 ounces) or one 5-to-6-ounce bag of romaine, chopped into bite-sized pieces
1 cup chopped cabbage (green or purple) or broccoli slaw
¼ cup lightly packed fresh cilantro
¼ teaspoon chipotle chili powder or regular chili powder
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
